- Simplified 3D scene complexity:
  - reduced dense geometry/material work
  - kept the corridor/action loop intact
  - lowered enemy counts on mobile

  - removed heavy standard/shadow/post-processing setup
  - disabled shadows and tone mapping
  - reduced light count and texture noise
- Improved startup performance:
  - lower pixel ratio on mobile
  - low-power renderer mode
  - minimal runtime overhead
- Kept the gameplay and UI intact:
  - move/look/fire/jump flow still works
  - screen and touch controls remain mobile-first

- /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js
- existing HTML/CSS remained compatible with the browser build

- Served locally and launched successfully in Chrome headless

- I assumed this is a static browser game (single-page HTML + ES module), so I optimized for the existing no-build workflow and mobile-first runtime rather than introducing a heavier packaging/build system.
